description: Erection of a single storey rear and part side infill extension, three side dormers, alteration to the roof of the rear projection, a rear roof window, two front roof windows and alteration to the front boundary treatment
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (18005-800, 18005-805-A, 18005-804-A, 18005-812, 18005-802-A, 18005-801-A, 18005-803-A, Environment Agency Flood Risk Matrix, 18005-815-A, 18005-814-A, 18005-810-A, 18005-811-A, 18005-813-A, 18005-806-A, 18005-809-A, 18005-807-A, 18005-808-A: Received 23/07/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, a splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the existing crossover, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the front boundary treatment  hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
